Name: Pitious Prey
Description: You conjure the instincts needed to track the creatures around you, and lock on to them. Choose up to two targets within the spell’s range, who you do not need to know are present. Each target, if they are within range, must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, you become aware of their distance and direction from you, and you retain this knowledge for the spell’s duration even if they move, hide, or teleport, as long as they are within 1 mile of you. Creatures who are not in this radius when you target them appear to have succeeded their saving throw. While you are aware of your target’s locations this way, they do not benefit from the effects of being invisible (as though you could see them), and you gain a +10 bonus to your passive Perception and Perception checks for the purposes of locating them specifically. When this spell ends, you may cast it again to extend its effects for an additional 10 minutes against the same targets.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell at 2nd level or higher, you can choose one of the following effects for each level above 1st:
●​ You can choose two additional targets.
●​ (2 slot levels) The spell’s duration increases to 1 hour, and when you cast it again to maintain it, it extends by 1 hour even if re-cast at base level.
